title: 皐月賞の後に・ざまあみろ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin conquers the Satsuki Sho, the first race of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Drawing the eyes of the entire racecourse, she proudly declares that the track is where she belongs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the stands is a young, redheaded girl who is moved to tears by her incredible run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket, having lost the race, firmly vows to win the next race—the Japanese Derby.
